_doc: Each rule is an anchored regex over the raw text of glob-selected files.
Rules match call/config *shape*, never secret values; matched text is never
copied into findings. Adding a rule is a data-only change (FR-003).
integration_markers (feature 014, FR-004): packages = literal strings that must
appear in a dependency manifest; imports = literal strings in source text. A rule
without markers evaluates as undetermined; zero marker hits = no-integration-found.

rules.title: CSRF protection disabled
rules.description: CSRF protection is explicitly disabled in the security configuration, so state-changing endpoints accept cross-site requests.
rules.recommendation: Re-enable CSRF protection (remove csrf().disable()) or document and compensate for every state-changing route it exposes.

rules.title: Wildcard CORS origin
rules.description: The CORS configuration allows any origin, letting arbitrary websites issue cross-origin requests to the API.
rules.recommendation: Replace the wildcard with an explicit allow-list of trusted origins.

rules.title: Sensitive endpoint permits anonymous access
rules.description: A sensitive endpoint (actuator, GraphQL, admin, internal) is placed on the unauthenticated allow-list.
rules.recommendation: Restrict the endpoint to authenticated or administrative callers, or justify the anonymous exposure per-resolver.

rules.title: Development console exposed anonymously
rules.description: An interactive development console is reachable without authentication, disclosing schema and easing attack crafting.
rules.recommendation: Disable the console outside development profiles or require administrative authentication.

rules.title: Wildcard or reflected CORS origin
rules.description: The CORS middleware reflects or wildcards origins, allowing arbitrary sites to read cross-origin responses.
rules.recommendation: Configure an explicit origin allow-list; never combine wildcard origins with credentials.

rules.title: Session cookie without secure flag
rules.description: Session cookies are configured without the secure flag, exposing them to plaintext transport and client-side access.
rules.recommendation: Set cookie.secure and cookie.httpOnly true; terminate TLS before the app.

rules.title: Django DEBUG enabled
rules.description: DEBUG is enabled, exposing stack traces, settings, and the debug toolbar in deployed environments.
rules.recommendation: Set DEBUG = False outside development; read it from environment configuration.

rules.title: ALLOWED_HOSTS wildcard
rules.description: ALLOWED_HOSTS accepts any host header, enabling host-header poisoning of generated URLs and password-reset links.

rules.title: CORS allows all origins
rules.description: django-cors-headers is configured to allow every origin.
rules.recommendation: Use CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS with an explicit allow-list.

rules.title: View exempted from CSRF protection
rules.description: A view is decorated with @csrf_exempt, accepting state-changing cross-site requests without a token.
rules.recommendation: Remove the exemption or replace the view with a token-authenticated API endpoint.

rules.title: TLS certificate verification disabled
rules.description: InsecureSkipVerify is true, so TLS peers are not authenticated — connections are open to interception.
rules.recommendation: Remove InsecureSkipVerify; pin or add the CA explicitly instead.

rules.title: Wildcard CORS origin
rules.description: The CORS handler allows any origin.
rules.recommendation: List trusted origins explicitly; do not combine with AllowCredentials.
